--font-serif.value: "Iowan Old Style", "Baskerville", "Palatino Linotype", "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif

decisions.decision: Use ivory surfaces and ivory-treated journey imagery with charcoal text. Omit tower storey counts from the opening screen.
decisions.source: Explicit user request; retain confirmed heights in later project details.

decisions.decision: Revert the ivory colour revision to original dark journey surfaces, full-colour imagery and ivory text. Keep opening storey counts removed.

After visual feedback, move to clean neutral charcoal/off-white surfaces, unobscured architecture, readable text panels and scroll-scrubbed official film frames. Keep all three wings and no opening storey counts.
decisions.source: User requested closer reference motion, improved text legibility and colour direction.

decisions.decision: One 58-floor tower; full-screen owner-supplied architectural film with restrained overlays and five reversible scroll chapters. Remove the opaque sidebar, old wing registrations and unconfirmed residence inventory. No floor count on the opening.
decisions.source: Explicit user scope change and repeated reference-led visual feedback, 28 September 2026.

decisions.decision: Preserve full-screen film narrative but replace low-resolution image scrubbing with seek-friendly HD video, eased chapter navigation and a deferred gallery of all 11 owner-supplied renders. Gallery images retain their full composition; mobile gets native portrait video crops.
decisions.source: User supplied local 4K master and asked for sharper imagery, completed Drive integration and more intuitive, smoother interactions.

decisions.decision: Replace the separate project-spaces gallery with tracked building hotspots and an in-scene architectural explorer. Retain the tower as spatial context, reveal owner renders from the selected point, and preserve the camera position on return. Use a touch-first immersive view on mobile; no invented floor assignments.
decisions.source: Explicit user feedback: amenities must be integrated into the live building experience, following the reference interaction pattern.

decisions.decision: Keep the original 58-floor hero tower, add lighter concept companions representing 43 and 53 storeys behind it, with no highlights. Remove building hotspots and the modal explorer. Amenities becomes the second full-screen scroll chapter immediately after the tower, reusing all eleven supplied renders.
decisions.source: Explicit user revision after approving the main tower render.

decisions.decision: Replace triangular background towers with a labelled source-guided side-view composition of three towers in a straight line on a visible podium. Retain original main-tower HD footage; add original Aikyam clubhouse footage with ground-floor gym, double-height squash and yoga, then first-floor banquet. Keep six navigation groups with room subnavigation, preserve wide clubhouse framing on mobile, and let scene transitions finish independently of scroll.
decisions.source: Explicit owner request and attached Purnata brochure, 29 September 2026.
